Class Penalty

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.penalties.Penalty
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
CrewPenalty, FlightDaysPenalty, GoodsPenalty, ProjectilePenalty
public abstract class Penalty extends Object implements Serializable
Abstract class representing a generic penalty applied to a player during the game. Subclasses define specific behaviors (e.g., loss of crew, goods, or being hit by a projectile). Penalties can be interactive (require player response) or automatic (for disconnected players).
